description: Westlakes Landing Center is a strategically positioned 83,617 square foot shopping destination located along Southwest Loop 410 in San Antonio, Texas, just west of Highway 151. The center benefits from exceptional visibility and accessibility, with more than 105,000 vehicles passing by daily on Loop 410, making it one of the most trafficked retail corridors in west San Antonio. Anchored by Santikos Entertainment, a popular movie theater and entertainment venue, Westlakes Landing has established itself as a community gathering place that combines retail, services, and entertainment. The tenant mix includes well-known national brands such as Sherwin Williams paint store and State Farm insurance, alongside local service providers like World Finance, creating a diverse offering that serves the everyday needs of the surrounding community. Managed by Valcor Commercial Real Estate, the center offers multiple suite sizes ranging from 900 to 2,610 square feet, plus a one-acre pad site available for build-to-suit opportunities, demonstrating ongoing investment and growth potential in this thriving west San Antonio location.
